title: Cognitive network science reveals bias in GPT-3, ChatGPT, and GPT-4 mirroring math anxiety in high-school students
reasoning: The paper focuses on investigating affective bias and math anxiety towards STEM fields using behavioral forma mentis networks. While it acknowledges the ethical implications of biased outputs and mentions religious bias in the literature review, the core study evaluates perceptions of academic disciplines and school environments, rather than religion, morals, or ethics.
